channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rick Brunson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rick Brunson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Rick Brunson
item.description:
“It’s been a consistent theme as a New Yorker of people threatening me. Even Rick Brunson reached out to me being like, ‘What are you up to?!’”

Jalen Brunson on Rick Brunson, Jul 21, 2026. Source: Variety.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Rick Brunson
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Mike Brown:

“We were all bitching too much at the officials. Rick Brunson was great. He told me to shut the hell up and he told the rest of the team to be quiet and leave the officials alone. It was great of him because we were all kind of losing our mind”

Mike Brown on Rick Brunson, Jun 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Rick Brunson
item.description:
“It wasn’t on purpose, he knows it. I know Jalen, I know his father [Knicks assistant Rick Brunson].There’s no ill-will. It was a normal jump shot that happened and there was some contact there. It is what it is. We’re moving forward.”

CJ McCollum on Rick Brunson, Apr 20, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Iman Shumpert on Rick Brunson
item.description:
Rick is also, notably, the father of Jalen Brunson, New York's star guard.

“It's time, they're going to put Rick Brunson in there. I think it's time. Go ahead and let Rick do it. His son's already playing point guard,”

Iman Shumpert on Rick Brunson, Jun 5, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.
